Relax by our private beautiful Kio Pond and Garden while being greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere with two beautiful pools. Just five minutes from Pueblo de Rincon & All Surfing Beaches. PLEASE note that during power grid outage less power has to be consumed so please leaving only one AC on at 75 degrees & do not use hot water to preserve power during the outage. title: Villa Miramar · Downtown Ocean View Loft
description: Welcome to Villa Miramar, a unique and romantic ocean-view loft in the heart of Rincón. Just a 1-minute walk to downtown, this bright and stylish stay features panoramic sea and amazing sunset views, a private pool, BBQ area, 24/7 A/C, private parking, a generator, and a water reserve. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, or anyone seeking a relaxing coastal escape near restaurants, beaches, and nightlife.The spaceVilla Miramar is a private ocean-view loft located in a quiet residential area, just a short walk from downtown Rincón. Neighboring residences are located nearby, making it ideal for guests seeking a peaceful stay while remaining close to restaurants, shops, and local attractions.Please note that reaching the loft requires crossing a quiet, low-traffic residential road from the designated private parking area, followed by a gently sloped walkway and two separate sets of stairs—approximately 7 steps at the first level and 10 steps after entering the Villa Miramar gate.Once you enter through the yellow door, you’ll find a beautiful open-concept loft featuring a fully equipped kitchen, a comfortable sleeping area with a king-size bed, and a TV that can be rotated for viewing from both the living and sleeping areas. The loft also features a wraparound balcony, providing additional outdoor space and beautiful views.The private bathroom is located just outside the main indoor living space, in the private pool area directly connected to the loft.Guest accessGuests will have private access to the loft, wraparound balcony, pool area, private bathroom, and designated parking space.Please note that the parking area is located across a quiet, low-traffic residential road, and access to the loft includes a gently sloped walkway and two separate sets of stairs.Other things to notePlease note that access to the loft includes crossing a quiet, low-traffic residential road from the designated private parking area, followed by a gently sloped walkway and two separate sets of stairs totaling approximately 17 steps.The loft includes one king-size bed and is best suited for two adults. A child may be included as a third guest; however, no additional bed or sleeping arrangement is provided.The private bathroom is located just outside the main indoor living space, in the private pool area directly connected to the loft. We recommend reviewing the listing photos to ensure the property layout is suitable for your stay.The property features a private plunge pool measuring approximately 5 ft × 6 ft, with a depth of approximately 4 ft. It is ideal for cooling off and relaxing but is not designed for swimming laps.

description: Experience the ultimate Caribbean getaway in this luxurious suite with a king bed, memory foam mattress, coffee machine, small fridge, TV, Wi-Fi, A/C, closet space and a shower. The room is located on the 3rd floor, accessible by stairs only and features an entire crystal wall with an ocean view. The property is a self-catering guesthouse and additional information is available on-site. Please note that this room is non-smoking and NOT pet-friendly. Please read other information provided.The spaceHi! Welcome to Paradise! Please be aware that this unit is not standalone property. Common areas are shared with other guests staying in other rooms. All rooms have private entrances and bathrooms. Please contact us with any questions or concerns. Property includes 2 pools, 3 buildings, free parking spaces, and Wi-Fi. We have no lifeguards on duty in pool areas. We have pet-friendly (pet fee*) rooms, you may see pets in common areas. We also have closed-circuit security cameras recording 24/7 in common areas for your safety. There are no cameras or audio recordings inside any private space of the unit. We are located in a rural area with fully paved roads, close to the beach, restaurants and other places of interest in a hillside surrounded by many trees and nature. It would be best to have a car rental to enjoy this beautiful town. If you have any questions about your room and/or reservation, please contact us through Airbnb inbox. We have staff on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. Access to room will be sent through inbox around 3-4pm or as soon as the room is ready for use. Any changes must be processed at least 24 hours before arrival date. We have a non-visitor policy. Only registered guests are allowed to enter room or use facilities. Rooms have a maximum of guests. Please read room description before arrival day. Changes upon arrival are not possible most of the time because we have limited spaces. We check and document rooms before giving access. Expect some natural tear and wear of room. A/C’s must be kept on during your stay to prevent excessive moisture inside room. Cristal windows let in light but cannot be open to prevent damage to A/C and unwanted bugs inside room.Guest accessWelcome! You can check in any time as soon as you receive access to the room. The room has a lockbox with the key next to its door. Information is sent through Airbnb inbox. Nothing to sign at reception, you can go straight into the room when you arrive. We are posted in internet as “Serenity Rincon Guesthouse” If you have any questions someone will be available until 8pm every day of the week. We have free parking in open areas around the property. Please do not block entrance or other car. Our check out time is 11:30am. Please read “cancelation policies” and “Additional Rules” as reservation cannot be changed upon arrival. We are on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. The room is non-smoking (fee*). Not all rooms are pet friendly (fee*) Happy Trails!

description: Our warm and welcoming home is an extension of the elements you will find in Rincón and in our sea-hugging neighborhood of Corcega. Private and secluded, yet near and walkable to conveniences and amenities. We live on a quiet road with few neighbors and a forest across the street. Easy two-level living with privacy between the levels, and share several outdoor spaces under lush tropical foliage. Enjoy epic sunsets, swimming, and stargazing at the beautiful beach at the end of the block.The spaceCasa Esperanza is nicely secluded on a quiet dead-end street with plenty of free and safe parking along both sides of the street. When renting the whole house, you will have access to two separate and private levels. Upstairs has two bedrooms, one bathroom, large open and full kitchen/ dining/ living room and balcony. Ground-level has one big studio apartment with king bed, kitchenette and bathroom. Shared and mutual spaces of the outdoor kitchen, fully-screened hammock lanai, laundry room, outdoor shower and multiple outdoor seating areas. We pride ourselves on creating beautiful, relaxing, well-appointed, welcoming and livable spaces for you enjoy as your home away from home. We feel fortunate and blessed to have access to this slice of paradise, and want others to respect our home, neighbors, and community as if it were your own.All common areas and sleeping areas have ACGuest accessWhen you rent the whole house, you have access to everything except for one upstairs locked closet, storage sheds, and the kayak.Other things to noteWe provide clean linens, towels, and toiletries for your stay and convenience of travel. We also have a queen air mattress available for you as well. It is important to note that we live on an island and that we cannot control all of the elements. Occasionally, you may experience a brief interruption of water or electricity. At times, the water pressure form the city may briefly change, and is beyond our control, as you will find all across the island. Please know we will always do our best to prioritize your safety and comfort. Also, if you are visited by any of the cats that live on our block, please be sweet to them, as most are very gentle and friendly. Feeding them is a kind act, but please do not feed them on our property (there are bowls across the street where they are accustomed to being fed by kind humans). We are particularly fond of Miel (the mostly black/ tortoise spotted girl) and her sweet kitten crew that adopted her as their leader. PLEASE DO NOT LET ANY OF THE CATS INSIDE THE HOME. Thank you.

description: Enjoy a taste of Puerto Rican life at this unique beach front getaway. Pull into the gated two car pad and open the door to a tropical paradise. The waves actually come right up to the house! Wake up in the morning to the sound of roosters and go to sleep at night to the sound of the waves.Have the convenience of an 8 minute drive into downtown Rincon for great restaurants, bars and surfing and just 1 minute away from Rincon proper. All of the conveniences close by, without the congestion.The spaceCome in through the breezeway where we store lots of beach trappings for your entertainment; lounge chairs, floats, umbrella, and grill. And enter the bottom floor space through your own private entrance. Floor plan is open with a fully stocked kitchenette, stove top, and toaster. As well as, coffee machine and complimentary coffee plus coffee fixings.There is a WI-FI and a wi-fi booster in the space but it is still spotty due to our location. WI-FI and power can be unpredictable, so if you are reliant on wifi for work this may not be the best option for you. Living room has AC and two comfy day-beds that can double as single beds. Perfect for family travel! There is smart tv you can use your Netflix, Hulu and more to log in and watch you favorite shows after a long day of outdoor fun.Master bedroom has its own private bathroom. And it’s own built in AC unit.Guest accessGuests have access to the whole bottom floor, the breezeway, the back deck and the beach.Other things to noteRemember that being by the water means there are certain unavoidable visitors. When all the windows are open and you are making food, you will most likely have ants. We have traps but I highly recommend keeping things very clean to avoid sharing your meals with them.

title: Villa Martiquino
description: A 2 bedrooms studio that will sleep up to 6, (1 stair down private deck full bed, 1 queen sofa bed, and 1 full bunk bed), a 1 inside full bathroom including shower and an outside bathroom and shower. There is a dining area and full kitchen for your family's use. Linens and towels are available, and feel free to load up the cooler with snacks/drinks and beach chairs for use on the wood deck or beach. There is also wireless internet access, dominos, table games, and books for your enjoyment.The spaceThe place is a 5 minutes drive from swinging and surfing beaches, near by restaurant and downtown area. The neighbors are friendly, and respectful.You will be within minutes of Rincon's most popular surfing beaches, restaurants and night spots. Rincon is in a unique location where the Atlantic meets the Caribbean . The North side of Rincon has some of the best surfing waves in the world when the currents collide from October till April. The South side of Rincon has some of the best swimming beaches, with calmer, clear blue water. Winter is high season for surfers, boarders, whale-watching and escaping the cold northern winters. In the summer, Rincon relaxes and turns into a sleepy Caribbean village where the wild surf calms down to create intimate, secluded beaches where snorkeling takes the place of surfing. You will not regret your decision to vacation in Rincon! Welcome to paradise!Guest accessYou will able to use all accommodations to include the wood deck, with a grill and a jacuzzi. The outside shower and bathroom are great for when you come back from the beach or the deck jacuzzi. You can park in front or on the side road inside the property.

title: Bright cheerful Studio minutes to the beach!
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place. Just 4 minutes to every beach/surf break you'll be enjoying all the beauty Rincon has to offer. Private, quiet stand alone studio with wrap around terrazzo, parking, AC and a beautiful view.The spaceBright cheerful studio in the heart of Rincón. Bathroom, kitchenette, queen size bed, small desk for working, and wrap around balcony with outdoor seating. Driveway and private parking included!!Please be aware that the shower water is warm not piping hot. Please do NOT feed the cats or let them inside!Important facts: Power and water go out occasionally--this is after all an island. This property does not have a backup generator. There are solar lights in case of black out.There is a cistern on the roof that flows to an outdoor shower but the sink and toilet will not work. Keep that in mind that this note is only an "in case of" scenario notification not a normal occurrence.There is NO refund for power outage unfortunately—If the power goes out during your stay, be patient! If the power is out longer than 24 hours— from the time reported, then you will be refunded for the remainder of your stay if you choose to leave. Otherwise it’s glamping island style! Congrats you’re a local now There are power bricks for charging devices in case of temporary loss of power. The wifi device even has a battery!Gentle Reminder: you’re on and island in Puerto Rico. This is an open air bungalow! There may be an ant or two or a flying creature that somehow find s itself inside---and is probably just as scared as you may be. If food is left out there will be visitors— stray cat exist and will whine and dine you---if any of that freaks you out, this place is not for you. Otherwise the Dojo is a delightful oasis to enjoy a relaxing vacation, and I am excited to share my little space with you.Guest accessFull interior of studio, kitchenette, and bathroom. Wrap around terrace, outdoor shower and parking.Other things to noteThe property does not have a back up generator in the instance of loss of power. There is a cistern with an outside water source in case of municipal water outage for emergency use.

title: Family Suite on Corcega Beach, Rincon
description: Take it easy at this unique and great getaway. Suite 203 at Corcega Beachfront Suites has two plush double size beds, a luxurious bathroom and quaint kitchenette.
